title: ze_shadow_moses
description:
An elite special forces unit known as FOXHOUND has gone rogue and seized control of a secret nuclear weapons disposal facility on Shadow Moses, Alaska.

The terrorists threaten the United States government. They claim to possess a mobile nuclear weapon capable of launching a strike from anywhere in the world: Metal Gear REX, and a biological virus turning soldiers into zombies.

Infiltrate the facility, plant C4 charges at every strategic location, and escape before the entire base explodes.

_ Don't touch the beams of light
_ KZ only recquire one player to trigger
_ Bosses
_ Epic music
